name: GRIEVANCE
note: THE HEARSE AND GRIEVANCE AT THE GATE (doc 110 section 2; reference/act3-hearse/brief.md operation 1): the coffin inside, behind the glass; Grievance in her black harness, facing up the hill, her head turned back to the hearse. Examined through THE HEARSE and GRIEVANCE, AT THE GATE. Declared by tools/extract-content.mjs once the picture is in the repository (errata 233). Drawn at Room 14's man at the gate, 298 px (reference/act3-hearse/handback.md), and stood on the open grass right of Mott's obelisk, which the hitch would cover in the gate itself (Tyler, 2026-11-09, of the first check render). Her size is ruled in content/scale-anchors.json.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, her head turned back a little toward the hearse · 1 a breath (derived) · 2 her head turned fully back, at the hearse · 3 a front hoof stamped once (reference/act3-hearse/handback.md). The hearse is the same in all four.
